title: LongCat-Video fp8 (24GB)
description: LongCat-Video (Meituan, 13.6B, MIT) in fp8 on a 24 GB card: text-to-video, image-to-video and long video by continuation. Needs a network volume for the weights; populate it once with {"input": {"mode": "setup"}}.

input.name: Quantization mode
input.description: fp8 matmul needs compute capability 8.9 (RTX 4000 series and up). Set to 'disabled' on an older card to let the loader autoselect.

input.name: Blocks to swap
input.description: Transformer blocks held on CPU. 0 on a 24 GB card; raise toward 20 if generation runs out of memory, which trades speed for headroom.

input.name: Attention mode
input.description: sdpa is built in. sageattn is faster but needs the extra package installed.

input.name: R2 account id
input.description: Needed for anything longer than a few seconds: a long video cannot be returned inside the response, and this worker keeps no volume.
